text: 近日，中国银行内蒙古分行为内蒙古和林格尔新区发放内蒙古自治区首笔“算力Token贷”。这笔贷款通过创新授信评价体系，打破传统信贷依赖抵押担保的固有模式，将企业词元使用规模、算力合作订单、核心技术资质、科创研发能力等新兴指标纳入核心授信评估体系，为词元经济相关企业量身定制专属普惠科创金融产品，开创了金融支持词元经济发展的新路径。 目前，算力产业已经成为呼和浩特市重点产业之一，全市算力规模达15万P，其中智算14.6万P，绿色算力指数位居全国首位。（新华社）
text_en: Recently, Bank of China Inner Mongolia Branch issued Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region's first 'Computing Power Token Loan' to Hohhot New Area of Inner Mongolia. This loan breaks the traditional credit model that relies on collateral and guarantees by incorporating emerging indicators such as enterprise token usage scale, computing power cooperation orders, core technology qualifications, and sci-tech R&D capabilities into the core credit assessment system, tailoring exclusive inclusive sci-tech financial products for token economy-related enterprises, opening a new path for financial support of the token economy. Currently, the computing power industry has become one of Hohhot's key industries, with the city's computing power scale reaching 150,000P, of which intelligent computing accounts for 146,000P, ranking first nationally in the green computing power index. (Xinhua News Agency)
